TEXT:
[FI] Akagi stood there with bloodshot eyes and heavy 
breathing.

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT: [FI] Huff... huff...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] W-What are you doing, Akagi...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [FI] O-Onii-chan? Why are you here?

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT:
[FI] Ahh, Akagi-san's big brother. What's the matter? Are 
you here to join the-

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT: [FI] ...[font_size=33]Huuuuh!??[/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT: [FI] Eek!

[FI] That bloodlust filled glare is just taking things too 
far. Look, Makabe is about to cry.

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT: [FI] [font_size=18]U-Um... Why are you glaring so intently at me...?[/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT: [FI] Grrrr!!

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT: [FI] Eeeek!

[FI] He's too far gone... This beast can't understand 
human language anymore.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] *sigh* This is why I told you to end your lover's 
quarrel outside...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I-It's not my fault!

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT: [FI] Yeah. This has nothing to do with him.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] Geez, why did you come here, Onii-chan? If you 
came to interfere with club activities, then go 
home!

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT: [FI] I'm not here to cause trouble...

[FI] Giving the crowded room a cursory glance, Akagi 
continued.

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT:
[FI] Everyone... Thank you for taking care of my sister all 
this time. I'm Sena's older brother, Kouhei Akagi.

SPEAKER: SPK_PRESIDENT
TEXT:
[FI] Y-Yeah. We should be thanking you. Your sister is 
always helping us. I'm the club president, Miura.

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT: [FI] Hello.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] I'm Gokou.

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT: [FI] It's a pleasure.

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT: [FI] [font_size=18]I-I'm Makabe.[/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT: [FI] [font_size=33]HUUUUHHHH!???[/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT: [FI] Eeek!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Hey, cut it out! If you don't have any reason to be 
here, then leave!

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT:
[FI] So if I have a reason, I can stay? Then this is 
observational study!

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT:
[FI] I'm here because I'm interested in the Game 
Research Club! I love games so much; I always 
carry one around, see?!

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] Isn't this... the game I gave you recently?! Why did 
you bring it to school?

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT:
[FI] I carry most things my dear Sena-chan gives me, 
or stash them in my safe① I've saved your 
Valentine's chocolate from every year there①

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [FI] Wha... I-I'm never giving you chocolates ever again!

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT:
[FI] No please, Sena-chan! That kind of mental 
punishment won't make me happy, you know?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [FI] I didn't say it to please you! You're too creepy!

[FI] Hey now, it took so much effort just to get on good 
terms, but sparks are already flying between you 
two.

SPEAKER: SPK_PRESIDENT
TEXT:
[FI] ...Hmm. You've actually played this soccer game, 
how interesting.
[FI] ...This time, someone unexpected spoke up.

SPEAKER: SPK_PRESIDENT
TEXT:
[FI] There were some horrible stories about how this 
game was rushed to meet the deadline...

SPEAKER: SPK_PRESIDENT
TEXT:
[FI] Players sinking into the ground, the ball veering in 
random directions, the clock going backward, even 
save data corruption...

SPEAKER: SPK_PRESIDENT
TEXT:
[FI] The [font_size=28]legendary game[/font_size] that sends the 
player to hell!

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT:
[FI] I'm not one to brag, but I managed to 
raise all the players to [font_size=28]max stats.[/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_PRESIDENT
TEXT:
[FI] [font_size=33]What!?[/font_size] You spent that much time on the mother of 
all shitty soccer games? What madness drove you to 
do that!

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT:
[FI] The moment I made the player's name "The Angel 
Sena-chan", my victory was guaranteed.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] Don't go raising me up in a soccer game! Did you 
name all the players after me!

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT:
[FI] But of course~ Sena-chan on defense, Sena-chan on 
offense, starting member Sena-chan, and Sena-chan 
on reserve! There is no better formation than this!

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT:
[FI] And the team's coach is none other than me...! This is 
truly Akagi Japan...!

SPEAKER: SPK_PRESIDENT
TEXT: [FI] I see, I see... Hey listen, I have a proposition to make.

SPEAKER: SPK_PRESIDENT
TEXT:
[FI] If it's alright with you, can you lend your talents to 
our game development team?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] [font_size=33]Huh!?? What are you saying, 
President?![/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_PRESIDENT
TEXT:
[FI] But don't you see? He has good taste in games. If 
he's interested in game creation, it would be a 
waste for him just to look.

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT:
[FI] He struck a nerve with your preference for shitty 
games, didn't he...

SPEAKER: SPK_BOTH
TEXT: [FI] [font_size=30]W[/font_size][font_size=33]H[/font_size][font_size=25]A[/font_size][font_size=33]A[/font_size][font_size=30]!??[/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT: [FI] Eeeeek!

[FI] This time they both yelled in unison. The president 
and Akagi make for a good combination.

SPEAKER: SPK_PRESIDENT
TEXT:
[FI] Let's get back to the topic at hand. Will you assist 
us in the production of our game?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] I am completely against this! I definitely don't want 
him staring at me throughout club activities!

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT:
[FI] I am in complete agreement! Being able to stare at 
Sena-chan while working on club activities, is this 
heaven on Earth?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [FI] Ah geez, Onii-chan... you're the absolute worst...!

SPEAKER: SPK_PRESIDENT
TEXT:
[FI] Calm down. Don't argue, you two. You both have 
your reasons, but let's look at the problem at hand 
here.

SPEAKER: SPK_PRESIDENT
TEXT:
[FI] Our club is severely lacking in members now. Ain't 
that right, Kousaka?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Ah, yeah... That's for certain.

SPEAKER: SPK_PRESIDENT
TEXT:
[FI] According to your schedule, there's a possibility 
that we'll miss the deadline for the festival with this 
amount of people, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_PRESIDENT
TEXT:
[FI] We can't use the club members who don't even 
show up, so why don't we make use of that guy 
here?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [FI] I'm agains--

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] I approve.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Eh?

[FI] Kuroneko interrupted Sena and raised her hand. 
Lots of things I didn't expect are happening on this 
very day.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] Lately, it feels that we are short-handed. Akagi-san 
has been handling more work than usual, but 
there's no guarantee she can keep this up.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] And besides that, our work is at a standstill now 
thanks to this dispute. We don't have the time to 
waste.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] Either a debugger staring at the screen till he vomits 
blood, or a masseur for his cute sister, we ought to give 
him a suitable task. Don't you think so?

[FI] Kuroneko looked my way. Well... both the president 
and Kuroneko are right.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Y-Yeah... that's right. Our bickering over Akagi is just 
a waste of precious time. Since our club president 
said to include him, let's go with that for now.

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT:
[FI] Okay, then it's settled? I'll come in here as I please 
then!

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [FI] Whaaa-!

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT: [FI] [font_size=17]...Eh...[/font_size]

[FI] Makabe... You're screwed one way or another this 
time. H-Hang in there, okay?
[FI] With that out of the way, work began...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Akagi-san. Is this CG okay with you?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] Hmm... Can you increase the amount of juices? 
There should be so much that it's collecting on his 
collarbone.

[FI] ...The two girls are having an unbelievable 
conversation. I'm so engrossed with the screen over 
here that I can't make a remark though.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] ...How about this?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] Ummm, I think something similar to an oily texture 
would look captivating... Get it?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] It's hard to understand the nuance.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] Sorry to be a bother, but can the President and 
Makabe try this out?

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT: [FI] [font_size=28]No way!?[/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_PRESIDENT
TEXT:
[FI] ...Hey, if Makabe's the model for the game, why'd 
you call me too?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] Isn't it obvious?! It won't work if we don't have the 
side that's shooting and the side that's shot on, for 
the President's Bukka--

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] [font_size=33]Stop whatever you're saying, right 
now![/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT:
[FI] Hey Kousaka, my little Sena's knows a thing or two, 
huh? She's so cool, almost like a pro.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] What kind of pro?! It's cause you pampered her so 
much that she turned out this way!

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT:
[FI] Hey Sena-chan, if you need some more materials, 
Onii-chan can pitch in and help, you know?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [FI] Shut up, Onii-chan.

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT: [FI] Kay.

[FI] ...Such a noble, good-looking man reduced to nothing 
with just a single phrase from his sister.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] Ah, but... Kousaka-senpai is here too, so you can use 
his face for bukka--

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] [font_size=33]Heeeey! Give me a break!![/font_size]

[FI] Watching us arguing back and forth, Kuroneko 
sighed and interjected.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] ...Akagi-san... You...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] I've been wondering for a while now but... Even in 
this game, do you not plan on holding back on your 
precious love of BL?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [FI] O-Of course... Of course I do.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] In fact, with your brother's presence, it's obvious 
that your delusions have been getting increasingly 
worse.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [FI] Onii-chan has nothing to do with this!

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT: [FI] Hey hey, don't quarrel, you two...

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT:
[FI] Hey you bastard, acting like you're trying to 
mediate, but you're just trying to sneak a feel of 
Sena-chan!? Huuuuhhhh!

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT: [FI] Eeeeek!

[FI] Makabe scowled at by Akagi caused him to curl 
himself up again. He's having a real bad day...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] That's enough, Onii-chan! You said you would help, 
but you aren't even doing anything! You're just in 
the way!

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] We're short on time, so go help out with something, 
got it?

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT: [FI] S-Sorry Sena-chan. Of course I'll help, yeah?

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT:
[FI] Ummmm...? Hey Kousaka, how do you do this 
"double click" thing?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Wow, you're more useless than I am...

SPEAKER: SPK_PRESIDENT
TEXT:
[FI] Hey, if you can't help out, wanna face me in that 
soccer game?

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT: [FI] Ah, sounds good!

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [FI] Sound good? Get real!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Why the heck are you even trying to play, 
President!

[FI] ...Utter chaos. I mean, it was chaotic before, but 
Akagi just made it more chaotic...

[FI] At this rate, we won't make it in time for the school 
festival.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] For the time being, stop playing at once, President. 
What are you even planning, inviting Akagi along 
with this charade?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] Yeah! You're the club's president for goodness 
sake!

SPEAKER: SPK_PRESIDENT
TEXT:
[FI] Geez, I was just helping the new member break 
the ice. Even I of all people do consider the needs 
of others.

[FI] Well, it is true that he does things in his own way 
for the club.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] But now's not the time for that. He joined us to 
alleviate our work and to keep to the schedule, but 
playing games will ruin everything.

SPEAKER: SPK_PRESIDENT
TEXT:
[FI] Hahaha, You really hit where it hurts. Let's call it 
quits with the game then.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [FI] *sigh* ...Thank goodness.

[FI] The President kept the game console while Akagi 
just looked on enviously while contributing nothing.

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT: [FI] I wanted to show him my Akagi Japan save data...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] You don't have to show him something so 
embarrassing! Good grief, I've told you that if you 
can't help then get out!
[FI] The usually calm Sena finally lost her temper.

[FI] This is bad, we're already behind schedule to begin 
with, but if this keeps up...
